notablePrerequisites:
Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents' life totals are NOT 1, 5, 6, 13 through 16, 29 through 36, or greater than 60.
description:
Equip Umbral Mantle to and then tap Hidetsugu.
Untap using Umbral Mantle's ability.
Repeat two times and then tap Hidetsugu once more.
